summary: Build practical EEO skills in fair hiring, pay review, accommodations, and complaint handling. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Equal employment opportunity training helps HR practitioners and people leaders assess hiring, pay, accommodation, and complaint-handling processes. Participants practise reviewing selection criteria, checking pay and representation data, and planning consistent complaint investigations. The course also covers AI-assisted screening risks and helps learners prepare an EEO assessment and action plan, while recognizing that data measures alone do not prove discrimination or fairness.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who influence hiring, pay, workplace inclusion, or the handling of discrimination concerns.
modules: EEO Foundations and ILO Convention No. 111
Accommodation and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
EEO Complaints and ILO Convention No. 190
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No prior EEO specialization is expected. Familiarity with basic HR processes can help, but the course begins with foundational concepts. Coding is not required. AI-assisted screening and automated selection are covered at conceptual and operational review levels, not through technical implementation.
